authority.runtime_identity_rule: live runtime authority comes from exact deployment/convergence/health receipts; repository or branch head is not live-runtime truth
authority.worker_status_rule: GitHub issue state plus preserved acceptance evidence is authoritative for current worker completion; this registry defines lane/dependency topology and must not override newer issue/evidence state

accepted_decisions.meaning: Core authority/control-plane is separate from parallel issue execution; dependencies block exact steps rather than whole projects

accepted_decisions.scope: bounded Oracle Codex Master Experience Floor only

legacy_or_retriage_refs.reason: original text says it blocks #117, but #117 is now completed by accepted bounded Codex evidence; #160 must not remain an active #117 dependency and requires independent retriage if any provider-specific work remains

invariants: worker completion never grants publication authority
live runtime identity is receipt-bound, not hard-coded in worker registry
issue/evidence state outranks stale registry snapshots
parallel workers may advance core/integration while other workers or exact-generation rollouts are active
dependency edges are scoped and must be removed or retriaged when their target is accepted/completed
